crossRefs.note: At evening, David arose from his bed and walked on the roof of the king’s house. From the roof, he saw a woman bathing…
Now therefore the sword will never depart from your house, because you have despised me, and have taken Uriah the…
“This is what Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will raise up evil against you out of your own house; and I will take your wives…
When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer.
Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.
Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.
Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.
Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat:
for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.
Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?
“Your own wickedness will correct you, and your backsliding will rebuke you. Know therefore and see that it is an evil…
If you will not listen, and if you will not take it to heart, to give glory to my name,” says Yahweh of Armies, “then I…
He will suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue will kill him.
They shall be wasted with hunger, and devoured with burning heat and bitter destruction. I will send the teeth of…
“Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”
